23. Bernoulli and Euler Polynomials--Riemann Zeta Function (p.804)
Mathematical Properties
23.1. Bernoulli and Euler Polynomials and the Euler-Maclaurin Formula
Generating Functions
23.1.1  [left] \dfrac{te^{xt}}{e^t-1}=\sum_{n=0}^\infty B_n(x)\dfrac{t^n}{n!}\quad |t|<2\pi   |   [right] \dfrac{2e^{xt}}{e^t+1}=\sum_{n=0}^\infty E_n(x)\dfrac{t^n}{n!}\quad |t|<\pi
Bernoulli and Euler Numbers
23.1.2  [left] B_n=B_n(0)\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n=2^nE_n\big(\tfrac12\big)=\text{integer}\quad n=0,1,\ldots
23.1.3  [left] B_0=1,\ B_1=-\tfrac12,\ B_2=\tfrac16,\ B_4=-\tfrac1{30}   |   [right] E_0=1,\ E_2=-1,\ E_4=5
(For occurrence of B_n and E_n in series expansions of circular functions, see chapter 4.)
Sums of Powers
23.1.4  [left] \sum_{k=1}^m k^n=\dfrac{B_{n+1}(m+1)-B_{n+1}}{n+1}\quad m,n=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] \sum_{k=1}^m(-1)^{m-k}k^n=\dfrac{E_n(m+1)+(-1)^mE_n(0)}{2}\quad m,n=1,2,\ldots
Derivatives and Differences
23.1.5  [left] B_n'(x)=nB_{n-1}(x)\quad n=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] E_n'(x)=nE_{n-1}(x)\quad n=1,2,\ldots
23.1.6  [left] B_n(x+1)-B_n(x)=nx^{n-1}\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(x+1)+E_n(x)=2x^n\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Expansions
23.1.7  [left] B_n(x+h)=\sum_{k=0}^n\dbinom nk B_k(x)h^{n-k}\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(x+h)=\sum_{k=0}^n\dbinom nk E_k(x)h^{n-k}\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Extra right-column-only line: E_n(x)=\sum_{k=0}^n\dbinom nk\dfrac{E_k}{2^k}\Big(x-\dfrac12\Big)^{n-k}\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Symmetry
23.1.8  [left] B_n(1-x)=(-1)^nB_n(x)\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(1-x)=(-1)^nE_n(x)\quad n=0,1,\ldots
23.1.9  [left] (-1)^nB_n(-x)=B_n(x)+nx^{n-1}\quad n=0,1,\ldots   |   [right] (-1)^{n+1}E_n(-x)=E_n(x)-2x^n\quad n=0,1,\ldots
Multiplication Theorem
23.1.10  [left] B_n(mx)=m^{n-1}\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}B_n\Big(x+\dfrac km\Big)\quad n=0,1,\ldots;\ m=1,2,\ldots   |   [right] E_n(mx)=m^n\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}(-1)^kE_n\Big(x+\dfrac km\Big)\quad n=0,1,\ldots;\ m=1,3,\ldots
Extra right-column-only line: E_n(mx)=-\dfrac{2}{n+1}m^n\sum_{k=0}^{m-1}(-1)^kB_{n+1}\Big(x+\dfrac km\Big)\quad n=0,1,\ldots;\ m=2,4,\ldots
